gloss: one lap, one circuit; one year (anniversary)

definitions.gloss: one lap, one circuit, one round
definitions.explanation: Going around something once; making a complete circuit.
The completion of one year since an event.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}を{一周|いっしゅう}する。
examples.english: I go around the park once.

examples.japanese: グラウンドを{一周|いっしゅう}{走|はし}る。
examples.english: I run one lap around the field.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}{旅行|りょこう}に{出|で}かける。
examples.english: I set off on a trip around the world.

examples.japanese: {開店|かいてん}{一周年|いっしゅうねん}を{祝|いわ}う。
examples.english: We celebrate the first anniversary of opening.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{一周年|いっしゅうねん}おめでとう。
examples.english: Congratulations on your first wedding anniversary.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{一周忌|いっしゅうき}を{迎|むか}える。
examples.english: We observe the first anniversary of grandfather's death.

notes:
{一周|いっしゅう} has two main uses.

SENSE 1 - ONE LAP/CIRCUIT:
- {一周|いっしゅう}する: to go around once
- {世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}: around the world
- {日本|にほん}{一周|いっしゅう}: around Japan

SENSE 2 - FIRST ANNIVERSARY:
- {一周年|いっしゅうねん}: first anniversary
- {一周忌|いっしゅうき}: first death anniversary (Buddhist term)

RELATED COUNTERS:
- {二周|にしゅう}: two laps / second anniversary
- {三周|さんしゅう}: three laps / third anniversary
